2027-09-11.title: Come and See
2027-09-11.verse: Jesus turned around and saw them following and said to them, “What do you want?” So they said to him, “Rabbi” (which is translated Teacher), “where are you staying?” Jesus answered, “Come and you will see.” So they came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. Now it was about four o’clock in the afternoon.
2027-09-11.observation: You could see the four Gospels as divided into two sections. The first three would be described as “this is how it happened,” and the Gospel of John would be described as “come and see.” One tells and the other shows. The Gospel of John is the “show me” book. John even says the major miracles Jesus performed were to show His Messiahship. He calls them “signs.” This is what God has wanted all along. For us to not just hear of Him but to follow Him. He wants us to come and see, then stay. We must be careful that we are not simply curious about Jesus or treat Him as a Google search engine. He is after relationship.
2027-09-11.application: Spend time with the Lord today. Go and see.
2027-09-11.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for desiring to know us.

2027-09-12.title: He Already Knows
2027-09-12.verse: He did not need anyone to testify about man, for he knew what was in man.
2027-09-12.observation: I will be honest and say I don’t love surprises. A long time ago, someone had an idea to buy me a particular gift for Christmas. They wanted it to be a surprise. The problem was it was not something I wanted at all. Thankfully, just before the big reveal, someone else came to tell me the secret because they knew it was not going to be a great surprise. I was so very thankful for the advance knowledge because it helped me not look disappointed. I was able to celebrate the thought and not the actual gift. I think the gift giver was also thankful for this breach of trust because it kept them from being disappointed by what would have been a bad reaction. We may not always think so, but it is a great blessing that God already knows us more than we can imagine. God is never surprised. God is never shocked. God is never taken off guard. He always knows. He is always already prepared. This is a blessing because we never have to wonder what His response will be. He is always loving, joyful, and ready to walk with us toward freedom.
2027-09-12.application: Take a moment to celebrate that nothing in your life is a surprise to God. Therefore, He is already working things out.
2027-09-12.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for being so much greater than we can imagine.

2027-09-13.title: Savior of the World
2027-09-13.verse: For this is the way God loved the world: He gave his one and only Son, so that everyone who believes in him will not perish but have eternal life. For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
2027-09-13.observation: There is a reason John 3:16 is one of the most famous verses in Scripture. In this one verse, Jesus explains the plan of God. The world had fallen to sin. It could not save itself. So, out of His great love, God sent His Son Jesus into the world on a rescue mission. In the plan of God, all three of the Trinity were involved. The Father willed it, the Son provided it, and the Holy Spirit draws us to it. The only thing we bring to our salvation is our sin. What a great God we serve.
2027-09-13.application: Spend today in thankfulness. If you have been saved by the forgiveness of God, you have already received the greatest miracle.
2027-09-13.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for saving us.

2027-09-14.title: We All Get A Part
2027-09-14.verse: For in this instance the saying is true, ‘One sows and another reaps.’ I sent you to reap what you did not work for; others have labored and you have entered into their labor.
2027-09-14.observation: In the Kingdom of God, there are no big and small roles. The roles are only different. They all depend on one another. The harvester may look more important because they are the ones bringing in the food, but there would be no harvest without the hard work of planting. While the harvester is working, the planter gets to look on in rest. His work is already complete. I heard of an evangelist who was well known for having many people saved at each of his meetings. However, when his friend retired from traveling with him, he did too. His friend had never been on stage nor preached one of the sermons. People did not understand why he would not find another traveling companion. What many did not know is that friend would go to the new location days before the evangelist and stay in intercession over the upcoming meeting. The evangelist knew that his friend’s work was just as important. Just because you are not always seen does not mean you are unimportant. God sees you.
2027-09-14.application: Celebrate the part you are playing in this season of life. Someone may be reaping a harvest one day only because of the planting you are doing today.
2027-09-14.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for making our every effort valuable and worth it.

2027-09-16.title: No Victims Allowed
2027-09-16.verse: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up. While I am trying to get into the water, someone else goes down there before me.” Jesus said to him, “Stand up! Pick up your mat and walk.
2027-09-16.observation: This poor guy was so used to being disabled that he no longer thought of himself as able to do anything without the mercy of others. Jesus challenged this by telling him, “Stand up.” The first thing Jesus did was not speak to his disability, but to his ability. God has given us all we need to do all He has called us to do. If He tells us to do something, He gives us the power to accomplish it.
2027-09-16.application: Read God’s Word and see all He has empowered us to already do.
2027-09-16.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us all we need to overcome in this life.

2027-09-17.title: Don’t Be Afraid
2027-09-17.verse: But he said to them, “It is I. Do not be afraid.
2027-09-17.observation: They are in the middle of a storm. It looks bad. No doubt they had lost friends before due to the powerful, unexpected storms on the Sea of Galilee. Then, they see Jesus. The first thing Jesus says is that their fear is over. They no longer need to be afraid. The storm is going. The circumstances have not changed. What changed was the presence of Jesus. When He arrives, everything changes. Now that we have the Holy Spirit living within us, we have the eternal God always with us. Therefore, there is no place for fear in our lives. So, even if the circumstances of your life have not changed, live without fear today. The King is there. Therefore, you will go through nothing alone today.
2027-09-17.application: Imagine God being with you throughout the day when facing your greatest difficulties. He is giving you wisdom. He is reminding you that you are not alone.
2027-09-17.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being there.

2027-09-18.title: God’s Timing Is Not Our Timing
2027-09-18.verse: So Jesus replied, “My time has not yet arrived, but you are ready at any opportunity! The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I am testifying about it that its deeds are evil. You go up to the feast yourselves. I am not going up to this feast because my time has not yet fully arrived.” When he had said this, he remained in Galilee.
2027-09-18.observation: I once heard someone say that, when God said let there be light, everything exploded into being. We are still living in the wake of those words. The point this person was making is when God created all we see now, He also created time and the timeline we are living on. This means He has His own timing for everything and He has a purpose for all things. God does not get up every morning and decide what to do. He already knows. His sovereign plan has been in place for a long time. Therefore, when God’s timing differs from ours, we should always trust Him. He knows what He is doing.
2027-09-18.application: When God’s timing seems different from yours, trust Him.
2027-09-18.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for knowing all things and working all things for Your glory. This means it is also for our best good.

2027-09-19.title: Be Free and Stay Free
2027-09-19.verse: She replied, “No one, Lord.” And Jesus said, “I do not condemn you either. Go, and from now on do not sin any more.”]]
2027-09-19.observation: Jesus is just awesome. He knew what to do and realized that everyone in that crowd was just as guilty as that lady. True, they had not been caught in the act of adultery, but they still were guilty of sin. This does not mean we cannot notice when someone else has sinned. We just do not become their executioner. We leave that to the Lord. I love how He set her free, but told her it was up to her to stay free. God will walk with her every step, but we must realize that freedom takes focus. We stay free by staying close to the Lord.
2027-09-19.application: Be free and stay free by staying close to the Lord today.
2027-09-19.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for setting us free from all the sin we are willing to bring to You.

2027-09-20.title: The Greatest Testimony
2027-09-20.verse: He replied, “I do not know whether he is a sinner. I do know one thing—that although I was blind, now I can see.
2027-09-20.observation: This is possibly the greatest testimony in the Bible. When the man is asked how he can explain what happened to him, he says he can’t fully answer all their questions. He just knows he was one way and now he is another. That. Is. Awesome. It’s simple but true. Sometimes we overcomplicate Christianity. The bottom line is Jesus has saved us. We were one way and now we are another. Boom!
2027-09-20.application: Think about your story. Who would you be without Jesus?
2027-09-20.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for changing us into Your glory one day at a time.

2027-09-21.title: The Lord Has Come To Give Life
2027-09-21.verse: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come so that they may have life, and may have it abundantly. “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
2027-09-21.observation: This verse has been used to say that Jesus has come to give us everything we want. This is not true. A rich and satisfying life is the byproduct of our salvation. We can live a life without the fear of death, because we know what comes after it. We can live without fear, trusting God to protect us, because He will never send us where He will not always go with us. What can you do to someone who says, “To live is Christ, to die is gain.”? The answer is nothing. When we finally realize that God truly is for us, there is nothing that can stop us from seeing life as rich and satisfying. Everywhere we turn, every heartache that comes, every joy we experience… the Lord is there.
2027-09-21.application: Have you ever thought about how you do not go through a single day or a single moment alone? The Lord is always there. Answer the question, “How does that lead to a rich and satisfying life?”
2027-09-21.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always walking with us.

2027-09-22.title: Eternal Life With The Lord
2027-09-22.verse: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live even if he dies, and the one who lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?
2027-09-22.observation: Jesus is not talking about physical death. He is talking about living eternally with Him in Heaven. This fact is hard for us to get our minds around due to the finiteness of our existence. God exists outside of space and time. We exist with boundaries and limitations. He does not. Explaining the vastness of eternity would be like explaining advanced calculus to an ant. Where would you even begin? This is how it is for the Lord to explain the vastness of eternity and the extent of His plan for us. Therefore, He simply says we will not die in an ultimate way, but remain with Him forever. This is a beautiful thing. We are able to be with the Lord forever. We do not have to earn it, only believe it and follow Him.
2027-09-22.application: Just like Martha, the Lord asks us, “Do you believe this?” It’s okay to say as one person said in the New Testament, “Lord, I believe. Help my unbelief.” Think about it and answer honestly. Do you have enough faith to believe the Lord even if you do not fully understand?
2027-09-22.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for inviting us into an everlasting relationship.

2027-09-23.title: Follow the Leader
2027-09-23.verse: If anyone wants to serve me, he must follow me, and where I am, my servant will be too. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
2027-09-23.observation: I think many people forget that Christianity is not just about asking Jesus to save us. That is the beginning. The next step is that we begin to follow our leader. That is where the adventures happen. As we follow the Lord, He opens doors, works miracles, and shows us that even our ordinary faithfulness is for extraordinary reasons. This is why I am so sad when people say that they are “bored” serving God. It makes me wonder if they are truly following their leader. True Christianity is anything but boring. It’s hard, painful, joyful, exciting… just not boring.
2027-09-23.application: Follow the Leader in everything and consider every day an adventure.
2027-09-23.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for leading us through every season of life.

2027-09-24.title: The King Leads The Way
2027-09-24.verse: he got up from the meal, removed his outer clothes, took a towel and tied it around himself. He poured water into the washbasin and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to dry them with the towel he had wrapped around himself.
2027-09-24.observation: Only someone who is truly confident in who they are can humble themselves to serve others. If you don’t know who you are, you end up serving as a means of gaining identity. You try to impress people or try to earn someone’s approval. Jesus didn’t do any of this. He took the stance of a servant and washed their feet. He did this as an example of how they should serve one another. He wasn’t saying we should go around washing people’s feet. (Don’t even ask.) He was saying we should always reach out and serve our brothers and sisters in faith.
2027-09-24.application: Look for ways to serve a fellow Christ-follower today.
2027-09-24.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for serving us by giving Your Life. That’s the greatest gift.

2027-09-25.title: Jesus Has Secured Your Eternity
2027-09-25.verse: Do not let your hearts be distressed. You believe in God; believe also in me. There are many dwelling places in my Father’s house. Otherwise, I would have told you, because I am going away to make ready a place for you. And if I go and make ready a place for you, I will come again and take you to be with me, so that where I am you may be too. And you know the way where I am going.
2027-09-25.observation: What a great blessing this is! I have heard many people try to talk through if Jesus meant this literally or if this was figurative concerning the way of salvation through His death, burial, and resurrection. I think we are missing the point. Jesus is saying that God wants all of us to receive salvation and be with Him in Heaven forever. No one is left out of this opportunity. Anyone who wants to come can receive this salvation. If you have asked Jesus to wash away your sins and serve Him as Lord of your life, your eternity is sealed. No matter what we face in this world and in this life, nothing can change the glory that is waiting for us.
2027-09-25.application: Take a moment and frame your current situations in the light of eternity. Ultimately, nothing can steal your salvation in Christ. How does that change your day?
2027-09-25.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for sealing our eternity in You.

2027-09-26.title: The Goal for Christianity
2027-09-26.verse: I am the vine; you are the branches. The one who remains in me—and I in him—bears much fruit because apart from me you can accomplish nothing.
2027-09-26.observation: Jesus tells us the goal is to stay connected to Him. When we “abide” or stay connected to Him the same way a branch stays connected to a vine, we will be able to do all He has called us to do. It’s just like trying to drive a car with no gas. That’s what it feels like to live for God without staying connected to God. Stay connected to God above all else. We do this through our daily time in God’s Word, our daily time of prayer, and staying connected to our Christian community. Stay connected and watch what it does to every other area of life.
2027-09-26.application: Develop a daily discipline of connecting and abiding with God.
2027-09-26.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for giving us the opportunity to stay connected to You.

2027-09-27.title: Maturing With God
2027-09-27.verse: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all truth. For he will not speak on his own authority, but will speak whatever he hears and will tell you what is to come. He will glorify me because he will receive from me what is mine and will tell it to you. Everything that the Father has is mine; that is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what is mine and will tell it to you.
2027-09-27.observation: The Holy Spirit helps us develop our relationship with God because He is God. We have to be sure we do not consider the Holy Spirit as God’s messenger or God’s servant. The Holy Spirit is just as much God as the Father and the Son. The Holy Spirit is the part of God that dwells with us right now if we are Christ-followers. The Holy Spirit walks with us daily and helps us grow. He leads us out of every dark place and into freedom.
2027-09-27.application: Every morning, ask the Holy Spirit to lead you in everything you do and everything you say.
2027-09-27.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for sending the Holy Spirit to be our daily friend.

2027-09-28.title: Our Mission
2027-09-28.verse: I am not asking you to take them out of the world, but that you keep them safe from the evil one.
2027-09-28.observation: Jesus said He did not pray for us to be taken out of the world, but to be made safe from the evil in the world. This reminds me of a brutal picture I once saw of two wolves. One of the wolves was strong and mature while the other was a small cub. The small cub had an arrow in it and was struggling. The older wolf had many arrows and was standing strong. The caption under the picture said the goal is not to avoid arrows. The goal is to become strong enough to not be defeated by them. This is what Jesus is saying in this prayer. The goal is not to be delivered from all evil, because we have lost people to tell about the beauty of God’s love. The goal is to become safe from the evil one by learning how to lean on God and becoming strong.
2027-09-28.application: Don’t see every bad thing as the end of the world. See it as a way to become stronger, because the Lord is with you.
2027-09-28.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for praying for us.

2027-09-29.title: The King is Here
2027-09-29.verse: Then Jesus, because he knew everything that was going to happen to him, came and asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They replied, “Jesus the Nazarene.” He told them, “I am he.” (Now Judas, the one who betrayed him, was standing there with them.)
2027-09-29.observation: They came looking for a man named Jesus. They found the King of kings, the God of all the Universe. I have heard so many stories of people who investigated the life of Jesus in order to discredit Christianity. The vast majority of them become Christians. They begin by looking at the man, Jesus. They end up bowing down to the power of God. Never forget that Jesus is no mere man. He is the King. The Creator of all things stepped into time, space, and matter. He became one of us so He could save us all. Praise the Lord for the King who became a man so He could save all mankind for all time.
2027-09-29.application: When reading God’s Word, always remember that Jesus is not just a man. He is God in human form.
2027-09-29.prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for saving us all.
